protocol.window: UTC calendar day, half-open; retain empty days
protocol.sampling: smallest hash of v1 namespace|role|numeric ID; labels not used; sort timestamp and ID; preserve v1 prefix
protocol.prediction: entire day snapshot predicts before any same-day learning
protocol.rebuild: latest 2048 learned rows every 2048 scored arrivals, replacing old tree; one insertion per row
protocol.scores: STORY and CATEGORY within-day ARI, raw and first-title; <2 rows null; primary post-cap horizon includes days whose prediction snapshot starts after first skipped insertion
protocol.comparison: paired per-day delta vs unbounded; full horizon and post-cap row-weighted means; report worst daily delta, negative/zero/positive day counts; no significance or universal winner claim; no threshold tuning
protocol.memory: fresh subprocess for each method/repeat, never parse source or load encoder; mmap prepared feature/label arrays; touch all file-backed pages before baseline; preload sklearn scoring/imports using dummy model before baseline; sample own process RSS and anonymous RSS every 5ms plus synchronous phase boundaries; report absolute memory and deltas above post-touch baseline; resource high-water RSS separately; serialized model size is a separate storage proxy
protocol.repeat: two complete deterministic repeats, no stochastic seed confidence interval
protocol.limitations: v1 prefix already inspected; extended horizon is a fixed continuation not an untouched confirmatory dataset; capped warmup could exceed cap, report rather than hide

runs.serialized_size_scope: BIRCH estimator pickle only; excludes rolling replay buffer and controller state; no restart checkpoint saved
runs.repeat_verified: all non-timing/memory fields and prediction digests exact; seven-day v1 prefix exact
